items.title: Kering turnaround hopes hit by drop in Gucci sales
items.summary: Philippine business desk carries the wire story on Kering's Q3 2026 results: Gucci sales fell 6% like-for-like to EUR 1.29 billion with retail down 9%, lower mainland China and Japan foot traffic cited as the core drag, and CEO Luca de Meo warning the China turnaround needs 12-24 months; a critical-angle earnings story reaching a regional Philippine business readership that watches Gucci's commercial health.

items.title: How the third quarter shows luxury industry can't rely on walk-ins anymore
items.summary: Asia-regional retail trade outlet analyzes Q3 2026 luxury results, naming Gucci specifically: revenue down 6% comparable with own-store sales down 9%, Asia-Pacific retail at -14% and Japan at -17%, attributed to falling walk-in traffic rather than falling spend per shopper; frames Kering's accelerated store-closure plan (125 closures in 2026) as the structural response, a critical business read for APAC retail/mall stakeholders.

items.title: Fan account posts: NINGNING at the 2026 LACMA Art+Film Gala (#GucciLACMA2026)
items.summary: International aespa fan accounts (aespaintl and others) posted gala photos of Ningning -- Gucci global ambassador -- following her November 7 appearance in a crystal-bra-and-fur-jacket look; this organic multi-account amplification reaches aespa's large Southeast Asian (Thai, Filipino, Indonesian, Vietnamese) fan base, illustrating sustained SNS volume around Gucci's K-pop roster independent of brand-issued content; outside commentary elsewhere called the styling overly revealing and "cheap," adding a mild controversy edge.

items.title: TikTok discover tag: "worst Gucci bag" quality-complaint clips
items.summary: A TikTok discover/hashtag cluster aggregates user clips airing quality complaints about Gucci bags (defective stitching, water damage, loose hardware); a recurring critical-angle theme surfacing independent of Gucci's campaign cycle, relevant to Southeast Asia's price-sensitive, resale-conscious luxury shoppers though individual posters' regions are not verifiable and no public like/view counts were visible on the aggregator page.
